originalPrompt:
## Context & Goal

Integrate the Cal.com toolkit into VoiceOS via Composio using OAuth2. This enables the VoiceOS agent to manage bookings, event types, and availability on behalf of authenticated users. James will need to implement UX/UI flows including OAuth2 connection screens, confirmation pop-ups before cancelling bookings, and action feedback toasts.

## Implementation Requirements

- Use **Composio** as the MCP provider for all Cal.com tool calls
- Auth method: **OAuth2** — implement the Composio OAuth2 connection flow for Cal.com
- Expose only the following **approved tools** (no others):
    - `Get bookings`
    - `Create booking`
    - `Cancel booking`
    - `Reschedule booking`
    - `Get event types`
    - `Get availability`
    - `Create event type`
- UX/UI requirements:
    - OAuth2 connect/disconnect UI for Cal.com account linking
    - Confirmation pop-up before `Cancel booking` and `Reschedule booking` (irreversible/impactful actions)
    - Success/error toast notifications for all write operations
    - Loading states during API calls
    - Clear error messaging if OAuth token expires or is revoked

## Relevant Files / Code Paths

- Composio SDK integration layer
- OAuth2 connection flow component
- Tool execution handler

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ]  Cal.com OAuth2 connection flow works end-to-end via Composio
- [ ]  All 7 approved tools are callable by the VoiceOS agent
- [ ]  No unapproved tools are exposed
- [ ]  Confirmation dialog appears before `Cancel booking` and `Reschedule booking`
- [ ]  Success/error toasts render correctly for all write operations
- [ ]  OAuth token refresh is handled gracefully
